dedupe_keys.name: red ferroviara y tranviaria en la comunitat valenciana

description: Red Ferroviara y tranviaria en la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by icvficherosweb.icv.gva.es. Digital base of the railway and tram network in the Valencian Community. It is a three-dimensional network of autonomous coverage with implicit topology where the linear elements that make up the railway communication systems are collected, including the different routes, ownership, categories, as well as the width of the track, differentiating between UIC, width Iberian ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Railway and tram network in the Valencian Community" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Conjuntos de Datos de Alto Valor, Comunitat Valenciana, Railway, ICV_CLAS:Transport;Infrastructures, Ferrocarril, IDEV. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2023-09-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
